svg.title: Karachi — The City of Lights
svg.desc: An illustrated Karachi night skyline generated from GitHub contributions, 28 Nov 2025 → 27 Nov 2026. One building per week, seven floors per building (one per day), windows lit on days with contributions. 424 contributions on 69 days; brightest day 17 October 2026 with 68.
svg.text: each building is a week of my GitHub year · each lit window, a day I shipped code
dark → brightest · floors run Sun → Sat, street to roof · 28 Nov 2025 → 27 Nov 2026
